messages.subject: Larkspur — settled position for board approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Naomi,

We've landed the licence with Calbryn. Final settled terms: £8m upfront (within 45 days), milestones up to £62m, royalties 7-12%, CAL-301 option £3m. Diligence longstop 39 months; Licensor liability uplift for title/no-conflict warranties capped at £18m. We think this is a good outcome and recommend board approval.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
